title: Flight Info Display Error — Gate A3

lines.text: Ops, this is Skyline at Gate A3. We’ve just restored our gate screens. But the FIDS board still shows our flight as 'Boarding' — it’s not even on the manifest yet. I’m not turning my staff loose on the terminal to explain why we’re not boarding. You need to confirm the data is clean before you turn anything back on.
Understood. We’re running verification from IT. Stand by for confirmation.
I need a guarantee, not a promise. If this screen flickers again, I’m pulling my gate team. I can’t manage passenger confusion on a bad data feed.

instructorNote: This inject escalates operational friction. The airline rep is demanding a verifiable assurance, not just a statement. Watch for Ops to request a formal verification process from IT instead of accepting a verbal go-ahead.
